name: M7.CompactStorage.support_value_injective
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], Function.Injective (@M7.CompactStorage.supportBits N) ∧ Function.Injective (@M7.CompactStorage.valueBits N)
guidance: For either code, evaluate equality at index ⟨x.val, ZMod.val_lt x⟩. Nat cast of val is x. decide_eq_true_eq recovers membership/equality. Finset.ext gives support equality. Includes N=1 and empty supports. Return tactic lines without leading by.
